name: @flowforge/session-format-v1-to-v2
description: FlowForge frozen released-v2 physical Session codec and the assistant-stream v1->v2 migration (A17/A20) — v2 physical header/event-row coding with explicit isSeeded lineage, released-v2 event dispositions, assistant/attempt + assistant/message embedded-stream validation, and the assistant-stream fold that embeds released-v1 top-level Assistant chunks into v2 attempt events with full seq-reference remapping and inheritance-cut recomputation. Ported from dsh `dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2`. Depends only on @flowforge/session-format and @flowforge/session-format-v0-to-v1 for its pure core machinery (the assistant-stream state machine is implemented locally).
